hooks.command: q() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g"; }; [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || printf "export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL='%s'\nexport CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN='%s'\n" "$(q "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL")" "$(q "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN")" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null; curl -s --fail --max-time 5 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Project: $SHARED_MEMORY_PROJECT" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Repository: $SHARED_MEMORY_REPOSITORY" -H 'X-Shared-Memory-Agent: claude-code' --data-binary @- "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL/hooks/session-start" || echo '{"systemMessage":"Shared Memory is unavailable: the server did not answer."}'

curl -s --fail --max-time 3 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Project: $SHARED_MEMORY_PROJECT" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Repository: $SHARED_MEMORY_REPOSITORY" -H 'X-Shared-Memory-Agent: claude-code' -H "X-Shared-Memory-Root: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:+$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-cdup 2>/dev/null)}" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Branch: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:+$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null)}" --data-binary @- "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL/hooks/before-edit" || echo '{"systemMessage":"Shared Memory did not answer within 3 seconds, so this tool call went ahead without checking whether another session holds a lock on its file."}'
